//parallelism: M6c (0.19.0). internal-parallelism is how many copies this machine runs on its own; max-parallelism is the hard ceiling; parallelizable: false forbids parallelism entirely. All three are optional: leaving them out means internal 0 / max 2048 / parallelizable true, i.e. exactly one copy until a parallel controller contributes (M6d).
//modifiers: M6c (0.19.0). A modifier names one structure position and the blocks that may sit there. While a matching block is present, its recipe modifiers apply: here a machine vent directly above the controller doubles item output. x/y/z are relative to the controller, whose own position is skipped.

modifiers.description:
Replace the block above the controller with a machine vent
for double item output!
